expected.title: Cohomology of a complex of modules agrees with that of its underlying complex of abelian sheaves, unboundedly
expected.author: The Stacks Project Authors
expected.difficulty_reason: The lemma compares, in the unbounded setting, the cohomology of a complex of modules with that of its underlying complex of abelian sheaves, in the three forms: global sections, sections over an object, and pushforward along a morphism of ringed sites (statement lines 4452-4469). The proof defines the three maps through K-injective representatives (proof lines 4472-4482), reduces everything to the case of H^0 of the global sections by the companion descriptions of cohomology over an object and of higher direct images (proof lines 4483-4491), and then constructs the inverse explicitly by writing the group as a colimit over quasi-isomorphisms into the structure sheaf, using the cofinality of the quasi-isomorphisms from bounded above complexes of flat modules and sending an element to the tensor product with the structure sheaf (proof lines 4491-4541). The author omits only the detailed verification that the construction is an inverse, a routine tail. The claim is H2: a long but fully written-out argument with one reduction and one explicit construction.
